Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us. Pakistan win the series and continue their dominance in the shortest format of the game. Australia have lost, but they have pride to play for and will look to end their U.A.E. tour on a high. The final game takes place on 28th October, in Dubai again, at 2000 local (1600 GMT). See you for that. Cheers!

Pakistan captain, Sarfraz Ahmed says winning 10 series in a row in T20Is is not an easy thing to achieve. Reckons that they have improved in the past couple of years and it's been a combined effort between the team, management and selectors and that has helped. On Shaheen Afridi, he says he is young but he had faith in him and the pacer repaid that showing his quality. Adds that getting Imad Wasim back in the team gives them good balance and he can even use Mohammad Hafeez too when needed. On the batting, he feels that they played too many dot balls and if they can work on that, there are big hitters down the order who can score big when they come in. Ends by saying that in the final game he will try out the guys who haven't got a chance to play yet.

Australia captain, Aaron Finch says they were just a bit tentative in the Powerplay and later Pakistan just piled on the pressure. States that there's a good reason why Pakistan are the no.1 T20I side in the world. Reckons they didn't judge the conditions quick enough and that added to their downfall. Feels there are positives to take as certain players came in after a while and played well.

Man of the Match, Imad Wasim says he enjoys bowling in the Powerplay. Adds the wicket was different to the one in Abu Dhabi as this one was better. Mentions that you have to see the situation and then make your plans accordingly. States that he knew Australia wouldn't attack so he kept pitching it up. Ends by saying that he varied his pace as well which helped.

Australia will be disappointed with themselves. They had done well to restrict Pakistan to a total under 150, especially after how Hafeez and Azam were motoring along. With the bat, they just couldn't hold it together. Imploded of sorts yet again. Plenty to work on for them. The presentation will be coming up shortly...

A fine win for the Men in Green. This is their 10th series win in a row in T20Is. No.1 side in the world in this format for a reason. Setting a rather modest total on the board on this batting deck, they came out firing with the ball and were electric in the field too, barring a couple of dropped chances of course. Got rid of the top order quickly, there was some resistance provided by Marsh and Maxwell. More wickets fell and Pakistan were well on top. Maxwell (who scored a fifty) found an able partner in Coulter-Nile and both kind of took it close, but the ask was just too much. Eventually, the visitors fell short.
Tye swings across the line, through mid-wicket and gets just two runs for it. It's not enough. PAKISTAN WIN BY 11 RUNS! And take an unassailable 2-0 lead in the series too.
Adam Zampa in for the last ball of the game. Andrew Tye will be on strike though.
OUT! GONE! Another wicket down. Full and just outside off, Coulter-Nile lofts this over covers. Doesn't have enough power on it and it's a simple catch for Asif Ali in the deep.
Full and wide outside off, Coulter-Nile swings and gets it off the outer half down towards third man. The fielder moves to his left and cuts it off, keeping the batsmen to two runs.
Andrew Tye is next in.

OUT! Good catch. And just the man you want under such situations. Slower length ball around off, Maxwell swings too early and skies it towards long on. Malik comes running in, settles himself under the ball and takes the pressure catch ever so well. Maxwell played well, but he just had a little too much to do.
Length ball on off, it's hit somehow towards covers for a single.

SIX! THAT IS A MASSIVE HIT! Wow. Out of the stadium. Length delivery around off, there for Coulter-Nile to dispatch and he does so. Throws the kitchen sink at it and thumps it out of the park. What a start for Australia. 17 needed off 5.

Beautifully bowled. Brilliant end to the over from Hasan Ali. Bowls the slower bouncer and executes it to perfection. Maxwell backs away but can't do anything about it. Australia need 23 to win off the final over.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.

SIX! Coulter-Nile gets in on the action. Crucial hit, this. Back of a length which just sits up for him, the batsman goes back and muscles the heave over mid-wicket for a biggie. The 50-run stand between these two comes up as well.

Is that a drop? Good effort from Shadab nonetheless. Length delivery on off, Maxwell backs away and slices it over point. Shadab out in the deep runs in, dives forward but just can't get underneath it cleanly. A single results.
Ahead of a length, on middle, a mistimed slog from Coulter-Nile rolls to mid-wicket. A single is taken. Maxwell back on strike.
Makes room, cuts it, but only a single. Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, Maxwell stays leg side and hits it to sweeper cover.
Fifty for Glenn Maxwell. His 5th in this format. Just punches it down to long on and gets to the other end. 33 needed to win off 12 balls.
SIX! That's gone all the way! Full and right in the slot, Maxwell goes deep inside the crease and hits this straight as an arrow. A flat maximum. Fantastic hit.
Wide! Another wide. Sarfraz once again just signals to the youngster to take it easy. It's been a superb over so far. Down leg again, Maxwell swings and misses.
Wide! Angles it down leg, Maxwell swings and misses after going across. Wide signalled. Sarfraz just asks his bowler to calm down a bit.

Another good delivery. Short and wide outside off, slower in pace once more, Maxwell comes down the track for the big swing and misses. Making it hard for Maxwell, keeping it away from his arc too. Smart stuff.
Makes room and gets beaten! This is a good ball from Afridi. Over 140 clicks, follows Maxwell seeing him make room. The batsman looks to heave it over the leg side but misses.
Doesn't connect well at all, but gets a single and brings Maxwell on strike. Mistimes this towards mid off and changes ends.
Swing and a miss! Takes the pace off it and keeps it well outside off, Nathan swings early and misses it completely. Good start to the over.
Shaheen Afridi is back on.
Short ball on leg, Maxwell goes across to pull it down to fine leg but misses. 13 off the over. A big one for Australia.
A misfield now. Pakistan looks a bit jittery out in the field. Maxwell drills it to covers where the fielder dives to his left and lets it through. Two to the total.
FOUR! That's crashed! No chance for anyone to stop that. Back of a length around off, Maxwell stands his ground and cracks it through the covers for a boundary.
Dropped! Another life for Maxwell. He slices this fuller length ball over point. Hafeez out in the deep runs in to his right, dives and puts it down. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Maxwell plays at it and gets an edge. It races across the third man fence for a boundary.
Low full angling in on leg, hit down towards long on for a single.
Gets low and and sweeps it through square leg for a single. Will keep strike for the next over.
Outside off, CN cannot get it past the off side.
SIX! Coulter-Nile gets into the act. He can strike them. They need 14 rpo and they have 13 from the first 3. Slogs this over square leg just over the ropes for a maximum.
Tries to go again. But cannot connect as well. Hits it off the outer half over the bowler's head to mid on for one.
SIX! Connects this time. Pure power. Gets low and slogs this over mid-wicket for a monster of a six.
Leg spinner outside off, Maxwell goes for the big slogs but fails to connect.
Just outside off, Coulter-Nile looks to put bat on ball but the ball whizzes through with great speed. Beaten!
Stays back and keeps it out safely.

Safe! It's brushed the off stump. Wow. And the bails still didn't come off. This is an absolute ripper from Hasan Ali. Lands it around off, it comes back in at great pace. Coulter-Nile is beaten as he looks to cut and there is some noise as the ball goes behind to the keeper. Sarfraz thinks there's an inside edge and takes the DRS. Replays show that the ball kissed the off stick. Ooooffff!
What's happened here? Did it hit the stumps? Or a caught behind? There is a woody sound. Let's see what the ball hit though.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Outside off on a good length, a play and a miss from Maxwell.

Angling in at first and then straightening off the seam, Coulter-Nile taps this down in front of backward point and both batsmen take off. There is a shy at the bowler's end which misses. Had that hit, Nathan was a goner.
The batsman hits it from within the crease. Two run added to the total.
Wide! Going down leg, wide signalled.
Nathan Coulter-Nile will be the next man in.

OUT! Superb fielding from Fakhar Zaman. McDermott works this towards mid-wicket and sets off. Zaman is quick to the ball, dives forward and in a single fluid motion he scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Had only one stump to aim and he nailed it. He didn't even look at the stumps. Wow. Excellent stuff. Even the dive doesn't save Ben.
Direct hit! Looks to be gone. Ben McDermott looks to be in trouble.
Stays inside the crease and keeps it out.

Dropped! Will that cost Pakistan? Afridi takes the pace off this and pitches it full outside off, Maxwell goes into the shot early and lofts it high towards mid off. Wasim there goes back, gets his hands to it but can't hold on. Three runs taken.
FOUR! Australia need a few more of these. Back of a length angling in on leg, Maxwell just helps the pull fine down the leg side for a boundary.

Yorker on off from around the wicket, Maxwell digs it out towards short mid-wicket. Was that a bump ball? Doesn't seem so. The fielder there didn't realize it either, hence he didn't really go for the ball.
Shaheen Afridi returns.
Flat and quick on leg, Maxwell whips it through to deep square leg for a single.
Wrists this full ball down towards wide mid on for a single.
McDermott is quickly off the mark. Gets forward and across as he paddles this down the leg side. Takes a couple of runs for it.
Ben McDermott is the new batsman in.

OUT! Soft dismissal, really. The Professor doing a fine job for his side. Bowls it full around leg, Carey throws his front leg out of the way to play the drive but gets it off the leading edge to short extra cover where Fakhar Zaman takes the simplest of catch.
Rock on the back foot again and blocks it out.
Quicker, flatter and shorter on the stumps, from around the wicket, Carey goes back and keeps it out.
Mohammad Hafeez into the attack.
Slower through the air, on off, Maxwell pushes it to cover. A very good over from the leggie. 2 runs and a wicket off it.
Spinning in on leg, Carey gets low to sweep and it goes off the glove maybe behind past the keeper. A single is taken.
Alex Carey to bat next.

OUT! Edged and taken! Shadab strikes yet again. Bit quicker through the air, spinning away from around off, Marsh from his crease looks to push away from his body towards covers. Gets a feather behind though and Sarfraz takes a sharp catch. Appeals loudly and the finger goes up. Australia in a bit of trouble now. 87 needed to win off 50 balls.
A single after two dots. Maxwell flicks it in front of square leg and crosses over.
Goes with the spin and dabs it away towards point.
Spinning away from off stump, fullish in length, Maxwell defends it off the outer half square on the off side.
Skidding off the deck, outside off, Marsh plays inside the line and misses.
Length delivery just outside off, pushed down on the off side for no run.

Direct hit might have got the job done. Maxwell looks to work it away on the leg side but gets hit high on his thigh pad. The ball rolls in front of point as the batsmen take off. Shadab runs in, gets to the ball and under arms it at the striker's end with a dive. Misses though.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for the Australians! Short of a length into the body, Maxwell with a little swivel pulls it along the turf through square leg for a boundary.
Shaping away slightly from around off, cut off the outer half down to third man for one run.
Full and attacking the stumps, driven back down the ground for a single.
Hasan Ali to bowl his first over.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over. Short and wide, Marsh cuts it through backward point and beats Hasan Ali in the deep. 95 more needed from the last 10 overs. When will they go on the attack?
Leg spinner outside off, cut through cover-point for a single. 99 off 61 needed.
Short ball outside off, cut to extra cover for one.
Googly on off, hit back to the bowler.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Leg spinner on off, punched through mid off for a single.
Brilliant from Marsh. Tossed up ball outside off, Marsh drives it through mid off and completes the run. Imad is done for the day, his figures read 4-1-8-1.
Short outside off, cut to point. Excellent from Imad.
On-drive past mid on for another run.
Full outside off, driven past covers for a run.

Direct hit and that would be close. Australia are taking the risky runs and it is paying off. Maxwell gets a soft leading edge to this on the off side. Babar hares to the off and throws it at the non-striker's end but cannot hit the target.
Short ball outside off, pushed through cover-point for a single.
Imad Wasim brought on for another spell.
Taps this to the off side and will keep the strike for the next over.
Length down leg again, flicked to square leg. Dot ball.
Leg bye! Length ball down the leg side, Maxwell tries to flick the ball but misses his shot. The ball hits the thigh pad and rolls to the leg side where they steal a leg bye.
Wide. Maxwell tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire signals a wide.

Another quick run. Good running but that could have been trouble. Marsh taps it in front of him to the off side with soft hands. They set off for the run. Afridi gets to the ball and throws it towards the non-striker's end but fails to hit the stumps.
Fuller on off, GM drives it to mid off for a quick run.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad. They pick up a single. Leg byes given by the umpire.
Short ball outside off, cut past point for one more.
Played to the point region by Maxwell to rotate strike.
Driven through mid off by Marsh. They pick up a single.

OUT! Finch holes out and Shadab strikes in his very first over. Tossed up ball outside off, Finch makes room and looks to go over long on. He gets it off the bottom of the bat and the ball goes to long on where Fakhar Zaman settles under it and takes a good catch. Australia losing their way and now require 111 runs off 81 balls.
Glenn Maxwell is the new man in.
Short ball outside off, Marsh gets a bottom edge to the off side trying to cut it. They cross.
Tossed up ball outside off, Marsh paddles it and gets it over the keeper and gets a brace.
Driven to covers again but straight to the fielder. End of the Powerplay, Australia are 28/2.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Direct hit but safe. Finch plays it late towards backward point and sets off for a run. Afridi hits the target at the striker's end but Marsh is well in.
FOUR LEG BYES! Errs down leg this time, Finch just helps it on its way fine and gets a boundary through the fine leg region. Leg byes given. Australia will look to end the Powerplay on a high.
Good stop. Full and down the leg side, Marsh flicks it through square leg. Malik from the deep covers good ground and makes a diving stop. Three runs added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Mitchell Marsh is the new man in.

OUT! What a catch! Shadab only takes beauties. A loopy ball down leg, Lynn looks to work it down leg but gets a leading edge towards mid off. Shadab from covers runs to his right, dives low and takes a very good catch forward. Stunning.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side straight to the fielder.
Wide! Wasim tries to follow Lynn but darts this down leg. Lynn goes for the sweep but cannot make contact. The umpire signals a wide.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short ball outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Full and down leg, Lynn goes for the swipe but gets hit on the pads.
Driven to the covers by Lynn. A good effort on the field from the Pakistan fielders.
Pushed to the off side to retain strike for the next over.
Now is happy to block this out. Length again around off, Lynn taps it out.
SIX! Lynn special! Length ball on off, Lynn picks it up and lofts it over long on into the second tire. HUGE.
Full and on off, pushed to mid on.
CL has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Steams in and lands it on a good length on leg, Lynn goes for the swing first ball but cannot make contact.
Chris Lynn is in at no. 3.

OUT! Oh, dear! Short is short! A total surprised look on his face and everyone else's too. This is a fuller ball in line of the stumps, Finch hits it back towards the bowler. Wasim gets low and gets his fingertips to it as the ball goes on to hit the stumps at the non-striker's end. The players appeal and the umpire takes it up. Replays show us that Short didn't have his bat grounded. Finch is not pleased for some reason.
A run out appeal is taken up. Short is the man in concern, touch and go this.
Leg bye! Short not quite getting his timing right. Another one down leg, D'Arcy misses his flick and the ball goes to the on side. One run added to the total. Leg byes signalled by the umpire.
Quicker ball on leg, Short plays it with a straight bat.
Finch has played it fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single. Leg byes given by the umpire.

FOUR LEG BYES! Darts this on the pads of Finch. Aaron makes room and looks to work it away. He misses it and even Ahmed behind the stumps fails to collect it. The ball rolls to the third man boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good from Faheem. Bowls this way outside off, Faheem goes for the cut but is too far from the ball.
Another play and miss. Length ball closer to the off pole, Short goes for the pull but the ball goes between his bat and pad.
Full and around off, driven away from the mid off fielder for one.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. One run added to the total.
Fuller ball on off, driven to covers.
Swing and miss. Full and outside off, it moves away from Short after pitching. D'Arcy swings and misses.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl from the other end.
Short has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single. 3 runs off the first over.
Yorker on off, hit past mid off for a single.
Strays this down leg, Short looks to flick it down leg but gets it off his pads to short fine leg. They run one for the leg bye.
Darts this quick outside off, cut to point. 3 dots in a row.
Tossed up ball on off, driven to mid off.
Off spinner outside off, Short pushes it down to mid off.
We are back for the chase. Aaron Finch and D'Arcy Short to open for the visitors. Imad Wasim will bowl the first over of the innings.
